fields.description: Issue features a lead story alleging Miami Beach City Manager Renshaw faces potential jail over alleged misappropriation of public funds/materials and discusses conflict over police authority and gambling enforcement in Miami Beach. Editorial content addresses Florida politics including Governor Fuller Warren and opposition to a proposed sales tax, with reader letters and coupons. Additional coverage includes hurricane warning preparedness and Red Cross/radio communications plans, Florida teacher education statistics, consumer/medical commentary on new ammoniated dentifrices, discussion of fictitious-name law compliance, and a report on federal action to ban large radio giveaway programs. Includes entertainment and nightlife columns and local advertising.
